Both RD specifications give the same jump at 21 (9.753312). I used the 26 age groups from 20 to 22 and compared deaths from all causes just below and just above 21. I fit a linear regression with an indicator for age 21 or older, with and without a separate slope on each side.

Crossing the legal drinking age raises all-cause mortality by about 9.75 deaths.

ANSWER: 9.75
